import json, re, chess
rules = [(re.compile(p),r) for p,r in json.load(open("/tmp/obench-cell-wn02rcc0/bench_opencode_regex-chess_b2qov310/re.json"))]
def run(fen):
    for p, r in rules: fen = p.sub(r, fen)
    return [" ".join(x.split(" ")[:-2]) for x in fen.split("\n")]
def expected(b):
    s=set()
    for m in b.legal_moves:
        if m.promotion and m.promotion!=chess.QUEEN: continue
        c=b.copy(); c.push(m); s.add(" ".join(c.fen().split(" ")[:-2]))
    return s
for fen in ["8/8/8/K2pP2r/8/8/8/7k w - d6 0 1","r3k2r/1P6/8/8/8/8/8/R3K2R w KQkq - 0 1",

 "r3k2r/8/8/8/8/8/8/R3K2R w KQkq - 0 1","4k3/8/8/2pP4/1B6/8/8/4K3 w - c6 0 1","1r2k3/8/8/8/8/8/8/R3K2R w KQ - 0 1","4k3/8/8/8/8/8/8/Rr2K2R w KQ - 0 1"]:
